events.description: 36. Omnibus Order: The Court DENIES Lawler's Motion to Compel at Docket 16 without prejudice. The Court HOLDS IN ABEYANCE the discovery motions at Dockets 29 and 31 pending a ruling on summary judgment. Lawler's motion for m ore time to file his opposition at Docket 34 * is GRANTED. Wasilla must file proof that it provided Lawler a copy of the video and is directed to file a response regarding production of the dashcam footage in a format accessible to Lawler. Wasilla h as until close of business on 10/16/2026 to make those filings. The Court will set the new deadline for Lawler's summary judgment opposition once those issues are resolved. Signed by Judge Aaron Christian Peterson on 10/5/2026. (JRF, COURT STAFF) Modified on 10/5/2026 to correct docket number.(JRF, COURT STAFF).
